reference.tag_difference: One docstring correction; no executable engine differences.

historical_identification.evidence: All five project commits inspected: no dependency manifest, lockfile, engine source, or installation metadata. No installed schnapsen distribution. Tracked cpython-310 bytecode suggests Python 3.10 but establishes no exact version.
historical_identification.selection: Latest upstream commit before the latest historical project commit; explicit substitute target, not proof of the originally installed engine.

upstream_comparison.differences: game.py and tests unchanged. deck.py docstring spelling fix. bots/ml_bot.py swaps zero-filled feature sub-vector lengths for None moves (total vector unchanged). No executable rule differences.

contract.initialization: Explicit 20-card permutation; alternating first ten cards to players 0/1; remaining ten in talon draw order; bottom defines trump.
contract.rng: Reference uses random.Random.shuffle. Python/Rust RNG seed equivalence is not required or claimed.
contract.scope: Reachable standard Schnapsen states, semantic actions, ordered legal moves, scoring, terminal results, player observations and perspective history. No talon closing.
contract.normalization: Card IDs 0..19: suits HEARTS, CLUBS, SPADES, DIAMONDS; ranks JACK, QUEEN, KING, TEN, ACE. Actions tagged play(card), marriage(suit), exchange(suit). Set-valued seen_cards sorted; hand/talon/won-card/legal order preserved.
contract.errors: Rust invalid inputs fail atomically. Python exception text, repr/eval, malformed duplicate-card states, generic 52-card containers and class hierarchy are not compatibility targets.
